notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Improved Physics-Based Throwing!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just pushed an update to the Journey Through the Undead demo, and it makes throwing stuff at zombies way more satisfying.

You could always grab and throw items before, but now the system has been refined for smoother physics, better accuracy, and more impactful hits. Whether it's a table, a chair, or whatever else you can grab, it now feels faster, and more fun to use in a fight.

Check out this short clip of me testing it out by hurling objects at some unfortunate undead:
[previewyoutube=q8bZqR0uw6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Give it a try in the updated demo and let us know how it feels!

Thanks for playing,
Dazzling Divine

notes.title: Journey Through the Undead – Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
🎉 The Demo is Now Live! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3683650/Journey_Through_the_Undead_Demo/

We’re excited to announce that the Journey Through the Undead demo is officially available to play!

🧟‍♂️ Blast through the first three missions as you fight for survival across a stunning, mutated world filled with relentless zombies.
🔫 Gear up with guns, melee weapons, and grenades to face the dangers lurking in a beautiful yet terrifying world.

This is just the beginning, we're thrilled to share this early slice of the game with you and hear your feedback!

👉 Play the Demo Now and Wishlist the Full Game!
Your feedback and support mean the world to us and help shape the final game.

Thank you so much for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear what you think!

Stay safe out there, survivors. 🧟🔥

- Dazzling Divine

notes.title: Updated to Unreal Engine 5.1
notes.content:
New Update Details:

- Upgraded the game to Unreal Engine 5.1
- Converted all foliage to nanite. 
- Improved shadow quality.
- Frame Rate Optimization.

notes.title: New Update Details
notes.content:
- Reduced the lower threshold for the zombies' randomized running speed. This makes the overall hordes slower, which provides player more time to get ready and kill more zombies before they get too close. 
- Lowered the volume of zombie screech. 
- Improved audio reverberation based on the location of the map.
- Better reload sound effect.
- Replaced AR4 sound effect.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
- Update to raptor AI, movements and animation.
- Fixed a bug with flip and roll while shooting.

notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.content:
- Performance improvements.
- Improvements to shadows and lighting.
- Fixed minor issues with the character animations.
